grow appropriately; however, she cannot take in so much that her kidneys will be overloaded and her glucose 
out of range. 
4 . d. To prevent additional issues like UTIs, kidney stones, and hypertension, which can impact already-poor 
kidney health, the client should eat a low-sodium, heart-healthy, high-fiber diet, and Ramen noodles are 
extremely high in sodium.
